entries.description: A support company focused on improving a division's ability to prepare and operate in difficult defensive situations.
strengths: Adds useful entrenchment in the current sample data
Uses a support slot instead of combat width
Fits many defensive and general-purpose formations
weaknesses: Does not provide meaningful direct attack in this sample
Its wider terrain effects are not modelled yet
typicalUses: Units expected to fight across rivers or difficult terrain
General-purpose divisions with a spare support slot

entries.description: The basic foot battalion: slow and inexpensive compared with mobile or armored options, but strong at holding ground.
strengths: High organization and HP in the current sample
Good defensive value for its equipment footprint
weaknesses: Low breakthrough and limited offensive power
typicalUses: The holding element of artillery-supported divisions

entries.description: A line battalion that trades organization and durability for concentrated soft attack.
strengths: Highest soft attack among the non-armored sample battalions
Adds offensive pressure against soft targets
Pairs naturally with infantry that supplies organization and HP
weaknesses: Contributes no organization in the current sample
Uses more combat width than infantry
Raises artillery equipment and supply requirements
typicalUses: Infantry divisions intended to deal more soft damage
Templates that can afford extra artillery production

entries.description: An armored line battalion built around breakthrough, armor, hardness, and a mixed attack profile.
strengths: Strong breakthrough in the current sample
weaknesses: Low organization and HP when used without supporting battalions
High fuel, supply, and specialized equipment burden
Final performance depends heavily on an equipment design not modelled here
typicalUses: Mobile divisions supported by motorized battalions
Concentrated attacks where industry and fuel are available

entries.description: Infantry transported by trucks, retaining much of infantry's staying power while moving considerably faster.
strengths: High organization and HP in the current sample
Fast enough to accompany mobile and armored formations
Adds a small amount of hardness
weaknesses: Still has low breakthrough and direct attack
typicalUses: Organization and HP inside armored divisions

entries.description: A support-slot source of soft attack that adds no combat width in the current sample.
strengths: Adds useful soft attack without line combat width
Requires less artillery equipment than line artillery
Fits a wide range of infantry formations
weaknesses: Uses one of only five future support slots
Adds some supply and equipment cost
Provides less raw attack than a line artillery battalion
typicalUses: Low-width defensive formations needing extra damage
Templates that cannot spare line width for artillery
